title: Add support for sharing=private cache mounts
body:
<!--
Thanks for sending a pull request!

Please make sure you've read and understood our contributing guidelines
(https://github.com/containers/buildah/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) as well as ensuring
that all your commits are signed with `git commit -s`.

#### What type of PR is this?

/kind feature

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

We reject `sharing=private` on cache mounts, so building Containerfiles fails on an option BuildKit has supported for a long time:

```
Error: unrecognized value "private" for field `sharing`: %!w(<nil>)
```

A cache can now have more than one directory. A `sharing=private` mount takes one that nothing else is holding, creates another only when they are all busy, and keeps it locked until the command it is mounted for finishes. Directories are reused once they are free, so the count settles at how many commands use that cache at the same time. `sharing=shared` and `sharing=locked` are unchanged.

#### How to verify it

Unit, integration, and conformance tests are added.

Also manually, start one of these and then run a second while it sleeps. The second one will get its own private directory named `[hash]-1`:

```
buildah run --mount type=cache,target=/cache,sharing=private $ctr sh -c 'ls -A /cache; touch /cache/mine; sleep 30'
```

```
/var/tmp/buildah-cache-502/
├── buildah-cache-lockfiles
│   ├── d23ea00874c48053
│   │   ├── buildah-cache-lockfile
│   │   └── buildah-cache-pool-lockfile
│   └── d23ea00874c48053-1
│       └── buildah-cache-lockfile
├── d23ea00874c48053
│   └── mine
└── d23ea00874c48053-1
    └── mine
```

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

Noting one pre-existing difference from BuildKit, since it carries over to `sharing=private` as well: `sharing=shared` takes no lock in buildah, so a shared mount can use the same directory as a `sharing=locked` command running at the same time. BuildKit's `locked` waits for `shared` usages as well.

Aligning with BuildKit would mean `shared` taking a read lock, which changes the default sharing mode for every cache mount. That seemed better as its own PR if we want to address it.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
Cache mounts now accept sharing=private, which gives the command a cache directory that nothing else is using
```
